name: HiveMind
notes: Hands-free hears your answers far more reliably, keeps a Bluetooth headset at one steady volume, and no longer cuts off first words.
"Speak now" is two rising notes and "got it" the same notes falling. Google's own beeps are silenced while it listens.
In hands-free, before the next box it asks what you didn't say, including the queen in every brood box until you've seen her.
At the read-back: "change paddle to brood pattern", or "I didn't say the queen was marked" to take something out.
Never marked queenless unless you say so. Many more misheard bee words fixed (Beezer, his eye, brew paddle, larvae). Darker grey text.
